Free Online Card Shedding Game

7 Cards Least Game Online – Play Free With Friends & AI

A tactical low-hand card shedding game where the goal is to finish with the lowest score at the table.

7 Cards Least is an indie card shedding game built around calculated risk, card deduction, and timing. Instead of trying to build high-value tricks or meld points, each player is dealt 7 cards and works to shed heavy liabilities. When you calculate that your hand sum has dropped to 10 points or less, you can declare "LEAST!" on your turn. If your hand is strictly lower than every opponent, you take 0 penalty points; but if an opponent ties or holds a lower score, you take an 80-point penalty.

🎴 Card Values, Relative Scoring & Penalties

In 7 Cards Least, card ranks determine how fast you can safely reach declaring range:

  • Number Cards (2 to 10): Worth their exact face value (2–10 points).
  • Face Cards (J, Q, K): Flat 10 points each. Unmatched face cards are your biggest early liability.
  • Ace (A): 1 Point. Low anchor cards that make ideal sequences like A-2-3.
  • Table Joker (0 Points): At round setup, the dealer flips one card into the center. Any card matching that rank—regardless of suit—counts as 0 points for the entire round.
  • Relative Difference Scoring: When a caller wins, opponents take penalty points equal only to the difference (their hand score minus the winning score). You are not penalized your full hand score unless the winner held 0 points.
  • The 80-Point Blunder: The caller must strictly beat every opponent. In a tie or loss, the caller receives an 80-point penalty, while the true lowest player wins with 0 points.

🕹️ How a Turn Works & How to Start Playing

Each turn follows a clean, tactical loop:

  • 1. Discard Phase: Play a single card, a matching set of 2+ cards of the same rank (e.g. 8♠ 8♦), or a suited run of 3+ consecutive cards (e.g. 5♣ 6♣ 7♣).
  • 2. Match & Skip Shortcut: If your discard matches the rank currently on top of the discard pile, your turn ends immediately without drawing! Your hand size permanently shrinks by one card.
  • 3. Draw Phase: If not skipped, draw 1 card from either the face-down deck or the face-up discard pile. If a drawn deck card matches your discard rank, it drops immediately to the pile.
  • 4. Calling Least: Before discarding on your turn, if your total hand score is 10 points or fewer, tap "LEAST!" to stop the round and trigger the showdown.
  • Multiplayer & Solo AI: Jump into a game using Quick Match above, practice solo against computer bots in AI mode, or create private lobbies with WhatsApp invites in multiplayer mode.
